title: Schneider Electric
summary: Electrical distribution and data-centre power specialist benefiting from AI electricity demand.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Schneider sells switchgear, uninterruptible power supplies and cooling systems, the equipment that connects AI racks to the grid. Data-centre orders have grown faster than the rest of the portfolio, and the company is expanding capacity in transformers and switchgear, both of which are in short supply globally. Grid interconnection queues are now its main constraint.

Technology Exposure

  • Data-centre power and cooling.
  • Grid automation and electrical distribution.

What To Watch

  • Order backlog in data centres.
  • Transformer and switchgear capacity expansion.

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 18 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.

businessMeaning: The binding constraint on AI capacity is electricity interconnection, not chips; that shifts value to electrical equipment.
investmentLens: A structural electrification story with cyclical execution risk; backlog is the leading indicator.
